display.purpose: AUGUR wordmark and page mastheads only; Georgia, wide-tracked.

lead.purpose: Opening lines, epigraphs, mystical asides; Georgia, italic-capable.

body.purpose: Prose and UI; Verdana, small, capped at 64ch.

label.purpose: Caption bars, kickers, form labels; Courier, uppercase.

data.purpose: Hashes, timestamps, seal IDs, post numbers, greentext; Courier.

registers.name: instrument
registers.purpose: Everything serious and evidentiary. Must read as an instrument, never a psychic app or an AI product.

registers.name: commons
#5f8a80
registers.purpose: The anonymous community board only. Hushed and welcoming, earnest not crude.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system is flat. No shadows, no glass, no glow. Depth is 1px lines and flat fills only.

effects.name: button-bevel
effects.value: 1px light top+left border against darker bottom+right
effects.purpose: The single skeuomorphic touch: a faint Windows-9x control bevel on buttons.

effects.name: starfield
effects.value: five 1px radial-gradient dots at ~0.10-0.20 alpha, on the body background only
effects.purpose: Faint dusk texture. Never above content, never over ~0.2 alpha.

motion.name: seal-ring
motion.value: slow rotation on the seal emblem only
motion.purpose: The one residual animation. Honor prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.overview: AUGUR looks like a serious, faintly mystical corner of the old web: a nocturnal observatory for dreams, kept by someone rigorous. Dusk-lavender paper under a barely-there starfield, thin square-cornered panels, muted dusty-indigo header bars, small system type. It runs in two registers split by purpose: the Instrument (faded phpBB-era forum) for everything evidentiary and serious (homepage, Registry, Verifier, Vault, About), and the Commons (anonymous imageboard) for the community board only. Above all it rejects the AI look: no gradients, no glass, no rounded pills. It reads as an instrument someone quietly runs in the small hours, not a product being marketed.
keyCharacteristics: Faded nocturnal old-web: dusk-lavender paper, faint starfield, 1px square borders, small system type.
Two registers by purpose: the serious Instrument, and the anonymous Commons board.
Faintness lives in chrome; reading text and hit/miss labels stay legible.
Evidence over persuasion: the homepage demonstrates the seal and shows hits beside honest misses.
Verdana + Georgia + Courier. No gradients, no glass, no rounded pills.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No gradients, no backdrop-filter, no glass, no rounded pills, no drop-shadow glows. Flat fills, square corners, 1px borders. The instant something looks glossy it reads as AI, the one thing this system may never do.

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: A page is Instrument (serious, evidentiary) or Commons (anonymous board). Pick by purpose, load the matching idiom, never blur them.

rules.name: The Truth-Signal Rule
rules.body: Faded sage means hit, faded mauve means miss, seal indigo means sealed-and-waiting. Never decorative.

rules.name: The Machine-Voice Rule
rules.body: Anything literally exact (hash, timestamp, seal ID, declared condition, post number) is Courier.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Wonder Rule
rules.body: Georgia is reserved for the wordmark, headings, and awed/mystical lines; never UI chrome or dense body text.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Depth is a 1px line and a flat fill, never a shadow. The only raised affordance is the button bevel.

dos: Do keep every surface flat: 1px hairlines, flat fills, square corners, the one permitted button bevel.
Do pick a page's register by purpose (Instrument vs Commons) and keep the idioms separate.
Do set every exact value in Courier and reserve Georgia for the wordmark, headings, and awed asides.
Do reserve sage/mauve/seal-indigo for hit/miss/sealed only.
Do spend 'faint' on chrome; keep reading text at ink and hit/miss labels legible. Target AAA where feasible.
Do let the homepage demonstrate the mechanism and show honest misses beside hits.
donts: Don't ever reintroduce the AI look: no gradient pills, no backdrop-filter/glass, no pastel radial-gradient hero washes, no glossy dreamcore, no rounded-22px buttons. The single most important prohibition.
Don't drift into psychic or occult woo: no crystal balls, tarot, moon-and-stars mysticism, fortune-teller framing.
Don't reach for crypto/web3 hype: no neon, no 'blockchain-verified' badges.
Don't use drop-shadows or glows for depth; use a 1px line.
Don't let Commons greentext go to the harsh #789922; keep it dusty sage. Don't let the board's looseness leak into the Instrument.
Don't lowercase or restyle the wordmark; it is Georgia, wide-tracked.
Don't use an em dash anywhere in user-facing copy.
